lines.en: Hello, Mia. Are you here to see Mrs. Brown?
lines.pt: Olá, Mia. Você veio ver a Sra. Brown?

lines.en: Yes. Her daughter called me and said she was feeling better.
lines.pt: Sim. A filha dela me ligou e disse que ela estava se sentindo melhor.

lines.en: That’s right. This morning she said she felt much better.
lines.pt: É isso mesmo. Esta manhã ela disse que se sentia bem melhor.

lines.en: Good. Did she say she was eating well?
lines.pt: Ótimo. Ela disse que estava comendo bem?

lines.en: She said she ate all her breakfast, and she said she slept well.
lines.pt: Ela disse que comeu todo o café da manhã e disse que dormiu bem.

lines.en: What did the doctor say about her leg?
lines.pt: O que o médico disse sobre a perna dela?

lines.en: He said the pain was getting smaller, and he said she could go home on Friday.
lines.pt: Ele disse que a dor estava diminuindo e que ela poderia ir para casa na sexta.

lines.en: Wonderful! Did she say she needed anything?
lines.pt: Maravilhoso! Ela disse que precisava de alguma coisa?

lines.en: She said she wanted some magazines, and she said she missed her cat.
lines.pt: Ela disse que queria algumas revistas e que sentia falta do gato.

lines.en: I’ll bring both. She told me she liked crime stories.
lines.pt: Vou levar as duas coisas. Ela me contou que gostava de histórias policiais.

lines.en: Perfect. She said she was waiting for you, so go in.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Ela disse que estava esperando você, então pode entrar.

facts.label: said + passado
facts.sub: Conte o que alguém disse movendo o verbo para o passado: She said she felt better. He said she could go home.

facts.label: disse que + passado
facts.sub: Use said para contar o que alguém falou e volte o verbo um passo: I feel better vira She said she felt better. O that depois de said é opcional.

facts.label: me disse
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: She told me she felt better. Depois de told sempre vem a pessoa. Depois de said não: She said she felt better.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela disse que se sentia melhor”.
compare.us: Em inglês, o verbo volta um passo: She said she felt better (e não she feels). Use said + (that) + passado. Com pessoa, use told me: She told me she felt better. Não diga “said me”.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She said she felt better.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: She said she felt better reports the words I feel better.
After said we use the present: She said she feels better.
items.why: We usually move back to the past: she felt better.

items.s: Told needs an object: She told me she was tired.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She said she felt better reports the words I feel better. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After said we use the present: She said she feels better. → Falso (We usually move back to the past: she felt better.)
Told needs an object: She told me she was tired. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A hospital in Glasgow · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Sunday in Glasgow. Dan’s friend, Mrs. Brown, is in hospital. She hurt her leg last week. Dan carries a bunch of flowers. Dora is the nurse at the desk. She knows how every patient feels.

“Hello, Dan. Are you here to see Mrs. Brown?” says Dora. “Yes. Her daughter called me and said she was feeling better.” says Dan. “That’s right. This morning she said she felt much better.” says Dora.
